summary: INNEOVA Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq extension letter regarding minimum bid price deficiency. The company failed to regain compliance by the initial June 8, 2026 deadline and received a further 180-day extension to December 7, 2026. No transactional event, restructuring, or strategic review is announced; it is a routine listing compliance update. The filing reports no offer, target, acquirer, deal terms, or board recommendation. The registrant is the issuer/filer. This is a regulatory procedural filing, not a special situation. What to watch: potential reverse stock split to regain compliance.
